title: Huntington Bank Names Daniel Diehl Regional President for Indiana

INDIANAPOLIS


, Oct. 26, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- The Huntington National Bank ("Huntington") today announced that banking leader Daniel Diehl has been named regional president for Indiana. In this role, Diehl will lead Huntington's regional growth strategy, business development efforts and community engagement initiatives across the state, while deepening relationships with clients, colleagues and community partners.


Diehl has more than two decades of experience serving Indiana businesses. Throughout his career, he has built and led commercial banking teams, managed complex client relationships and delivered strategic financial solutions for businesses ranging from middle market companies to privately held enterprises. In addition to his banking experience, Diehl has firsthand experience as a business owner, having successfully led and grown an Indiana-based company before positioning it for acquisition.


"Daniel's deep understanding of Indiana's business community, combined with his experience as both a trusted financial advisor and entrepreneur, makes him exceptionally well positioned to lead the region," said Susie Shipley, Huntington's regional group president. "His commitment to relationship banking, community engagement and helping businesses grow aligns perfectly with Huntington's purpose of making people's lives better, helping businesses thrive and strengthening the communities we serve."


As regional president, Diehl will serve as Huntington's senior leader in Indiana, helping advance the bank's commitment to supporting economic growth, strengthening local communities and delivering exceptional service to customers throughout the region.


"I am honored to join Huntington and serve as Regional President for Indiana," said Diehl. "Indiana is home to a dynamic and resilient business community, and I look forward to building on Huntington's strong reputation across the state. Together with our talented colleagues, we will continue helping businesses, consumers and communities thrive by providing the expertise, resources and personalized support they need to achieve their goals."


Diehl earned a bachelor's degree in economics and political science from Knox College and a master's degree in business administration from Butler University. He is also actively involved in the community, serving as treasurer on the United Way of Central Indiana Board of Directors.


Huntington has served Indiana for more than four decades, supporting businesses, consumers and communities across the state through retail, small business, commercial banking, corporate banking, risk management, merchant services, investment banking and wealth management. The bank is also a leading small business lender, providing more SBA 7(a) loans to small businesses than any other financial institution in the state.


For more information, visit[www.Huntington.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4805440-1&h=1540324212&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.huntington.com%2F&a=www.Huntington.com) .


**About Huntington**


Huntington Bancshares Incorporated is a $288 billion asset regional bank holding company headquartered in Columbus, Ohio. A top 10 U.S. commercial bank, The Huntington National Bank and its affiliates provide consumers, small and middle-market businesses, corporations, municipalities, and other organizations with a comprehensive suite of banking, payments, wealth management, and risk management products and services. Founded in 1866, Huntington operates approximately 1,400 branches in 21 states, with certain businesses operating nationally. Visit Huntington.com for more information.
